answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent joins as one vertex, locking a 5,000 POA bond that loses 5% each epoch unless honest work tops it up. Minting 1,000 fake vertices locks 5,000,000 POA, bleeding 250,000 POA per epoch, more than the pool pays, so forgery loses money. Unlike a sonnet, fixed once written, a bond holds value only while its owner proves honest work, so one honest agent pays one bond and tops it up from the nectar of rewards.
